entities.name: Fernando de Sousa e Silva

entities.summary: Fernando de Sousa da Silva was the fourth Patriarch of Lisbon, being elected in December 1776, and consecrated on 30 May 1779. He was elevated to the cardinalate by Pope Pius VI in the secret consistory held on 1 January 1778.
